title: Hierarchical alert-routing + tenant-aware Grafana folder templating for multi-tenant private installs
author: Sasha Kim
description:
Problem: Private installs run in multi-tenant clusters where a single global Alertmanager config causes noisy on-call rotations and lacks tenant scoping. Operators requested: (1) per-tenant alert routing that can escalate from tenant -> team -> global; (2) automated creation of tenant-scoped Grafana folders and dashboard templates to avoid manual provisioning; (3) a safe rollout path (canary tenants, automatic rollback) so upgrades don't impact existing customers. This PR implements a coordinated automation across Terraform, Helm values and small operator logic to provision hierarchical routing and folder templating.

What changed (high level):
- New Terraform module observability/alert-routing that generates tenant AlertmanagerConfig CRDs (uses templated receiver chains and route matchers). Module is opt-in via installer flag `observability.enable_tenant_routing`.
- Helm chart updates for grafana: values.grafana.tenantFolders.* that accept tenant definitions to generate GrafanaFolder and dashboard provisioning files via a chart hook.
- A small controller shim (bash + kubectl + k8s manifests, kept tiny intentionally) for initial bootstrapping and idempotent reconciliation during upgrades when the installer runs offline. Controller avoids long-running stateful code; long-term plan is to move into the metric-deployment-operator but scope kept small for this change.
- Prometheus remote_write and relabel templates updated to attach `tenant_id` labels where present; retention and remote-write sharding is unaffected by default.
- Rollout plan and rollback script added: `scripts/observability-canary-rollout.sh` which can enable routing for selected tenant labels, run validation probes (alert firing counts, dashboard render smoke tests), and revert if thresholds exceeded.
- Tests: unit templates for Terraform module, Helm value rendering snapshots, and an e2e smoke job in `ci/e2e/observability-canary` that deploys to the test cluster using 2 fake tenants.

Why this approach: Keeping the logic mostly declarative (Terraform + Helm) minimizes runtime dependencies for private installs and allows operators to review generated YAML before applying. The tiny bootstrap controller only runs during installer/upgrade windows so it aligns with air-gapped requirements.

Checklist:
- [x] Terraform module with schema and examples
- [x] Helm chart templating for Grafana folders and provisioning
- [x] Bootstrapping script + rollback helper
- [x] Unit and e2e smoke tests
- [x] Linear tickets linked (ENG-4921)

Backward compatibility notes: By default the installer leaves existing Alertmanager configs untouched. Tenant routing is disabled unless `observability.enable_tenant_routing = true`. Enabling routing will create AlertmanagerConfig CRDs and update Prometheus relabel configs. Operators should run the canary script prior to enabling globally.

Security & secrets: Grafana provisioning uses secrets referenced via existing KMS/HSM integrations; new secret keys are created under the same tenant key namespace. The PR includes a short security review note in the comments section.

Manual deployment steps (operator):
1. Set `observability.enable_tenant_routing = false` in installer tfvars (default).
2. For pilot tenant, set to true and add tenant definition to `values.grafana.tenantFolders` with a dashboard bundle URL.
3. Run `scripts/observability-canary-rollout.sh --tenant pilot-1` to validate.
4. If metrics and smoke dashboards pass, flip global flag and apply.

Related: This PR is intentionally complementary to the metric-deployment-operator work (ENG-4728). The controller shim can be removed once that operator supports folder provisioning and AlertmanagerConfig reconciliation.
commits: f1e2d3c: add terraform module observability/alert-routing with docs and examples
a7b9f0d: helm: grafana: add tenantFolders templating and provisioning hook
c3d4f55: update prometheus relabel templates to forward tenant_id label
9a8b7c6: tests: unit snapshots + e2e canary smoke job
review_conversation: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Can you add an automated smoke check to validate that tenant-scoped alerts do not route to global receivers? The canary script is a good start but would like a CI job too.
Sasha Kim (author): Added CI e2e smoke job that runs in nightly canary pipeline (ci/e2e/observability-canary). The job is gated behind a flag so it won't run in customer air-gapped CI by default.
Priya Nand (reviewer): Security: confirm the Grafana provisioning doesn't write credentials into cluster-level plaintext ConfigMaps. Please use sealed secrets or KMS references.

Sasha Kim (author): Confirmed. Provisioning uses existing secret templates and the chart looks up secrets by name; documentation calls out using sealed-secrets or external KMS. Added note in README and created a short security checklist in the Terraform module.
Liam O'Connor (approver): Verified smoke runs and terraform plan output for example tenants looks sane. Approving for merge after CI green.
CI (automation): initial run failed on helm template snapshot mismatch, rerun fixed by adding default dashboard UID in template (commit a7b9f0d).
release_notes: Adds opt-in tenant-scoped alert routing and automated Grafana folder/dashboard provisioning for private installs. Includes canary rollout script and tests. Disabled by default; operators must enable via installer flag.
notes_for_ops: Run scripts/observability-canary-rollout.sh against a representative tenant and evaluate the alert delta metrics. Keep observability.enable_tenant_routing false in production until canary is validated.
changelog_entry: Opt-in tenant alert routing + Grafana folder provisioning (observability). See PR 35921 for rollout instructions.
risk_assessment: medium: declarative changes only, but enabling requires creating AlertmanagerConfig CRDs which can affect alert paths. Canary script mitigates risk.
testing_summary: Unit snapshots for Terraform/Helm templates. CI e2e smoke deploys two fake tenants, verifies dashboard rendering and that tenant alerts reach tenant receivers only.
documentation_updates: terraform/modules/observability/alert-routing/README.md includes examples; charts/grafana/README.md documents tenantFolders values and secret expectations.
